    # Higher priority for bins with smaller remaining capacity (closer to full)
    non_empty_mask = bins > 0

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins, dtype=float)
    non_empty_mask = bins > 0
    if np.any(non_empty_mask):
        safe_remaining = np.where(remaining[non_empty_mask] == 0, 1e-8, remaining[non_empty_mask])
        # Priority increases with inverse of remaining capacity scaled by item size
        priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = item / safe_remaining
        # Cap the priority score at a maximum value to avoid excessive weighting
        priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = np.clip(priority_scores[non_empty_mask], 0, 10)
    return priority_scores

        # Normalize to [0,1] for stability
        p = normalized_remaining + 1e-12  # Avoid log(0)
        entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log(p)) / np.log(len(p))
        # Score inversely related to entropy: lower entropy (more skewed) gets higher priority

        if len(p) > 1:
            priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = 1 - entropy

            priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = 1.0
        priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = np.clip(priority_scores[non_empty_mask], 0, 1)

    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins, dtype=float)
    fit_mask = remaining > 0
    if np.any(fit_mask):
        target_fullness = 0.9
        new_used = bins[fit_mask] - remaining[fit_mask]
        new_proportion = new_used / bins[fit_mask]
        deviation = np.abs(new_proportion - target_fullness)
        priority_scores[fit_mask] = 1 - deviation
        priority_scores[fit_mask] = np.clip(priority_scores[fit_mask], 0, 1)
    return priority_scores
